card.name: The word pregnant after Advise
card.fires_on: The word "pregnant" right after "Advise" in counseling statements about fetal risk. It also fires weakly on "pregnant" after "use in" and on "pregnancies" after "All".

modes.label: Advise pregnant women
modes.description: "pregnant" directly after the verb Advise in embryo-fetal risk counseling.
modes.example: Advise<< pregnant>> women of the potential risk to the fetus

modes.label: Pregnant in contraindications
modes.description: "pregnant" after "use in" in a contraindication or warning line.
modes.example: ITY and HEPATOTOXICITY Embryo-Fetal Toxicity Leflunomide tablet is contraindicated for use in<< pregnant>> women because of the potential for fetal harm

card.plain: It lights up on the word pregnant when a label tells the prescriber to advise pregnant women about fetal risk.
